Gabriel collection news corroborates1988 P1 by November19/29; these later witnesses do not replace November15 earliest demonstrated knowledge. Assembly/shipment not receipt.

summary: Eighteen Darwin targets and two extra Daniell sources freshly read, four accepted current contexts reused. No conversation pairs; one November15 Daniell-to-Hooker-letter knowledge witness resolves prior pending lead. Same-author chronological sequence and future printed material kept separate. No export.
